name: A party of four on one field
result: --dev party=N grows a battle's list at BN6_SPAWN_ENTITIES with MegaMen on side 0 (BN6 keeps four actors a side): against HeatMan V1 (0x101) four stood, moved and shot from keys written at BN6_KEY_COPY; a partner at 0 HP left the field and the battle went on; the lead at 0 HP did not end it while a partner stood, and the partner's win ended it as a win (partyhp, partyend).
meaning: One field works on one core with BN6's own battle: the battle ends when every MegaMan is down. Not yet: who the enemies aim at.
